thread_text:
releasebot: Deploybot detected regression during canary for embeddings-service (eu-west1) — 3/10 canaries returned 500s, pausing rollout. Created hotfix branch hotfix/eu-embed-503 and a candidate image tag hotfix-eu-503.
maria: copying. Can you paste the failure logs? quick glance shows kernel OOM suspects earlier.
dave: logs: 
```
ERROR quant_kernel: failed allocate 0x1f00000
stack: ... (kv cache) ...
```
sean: oncall here. This smells like a quantization kernel regression from yesterday's image. Options: rollback to previous image (stable) or patch by disabling new quant path. We need expedited approval to either pin a previous sha or skip canary for a patch deploy. ops constraints? ops-bot, any constraints on skipping canary right now?
ops-bot: Canary paused. Policy: can skip canary if an oncall + eng lead ack and rollback plan in place. Max skip window 30 minutes for hotfix. Tag and release notes required. Audit log will capture pin action.
lucy: security checked the hotfix branch diff — no new secrets or widened permissions. +1 from sec.
ben: I can build and push a quick image. Plan: build with env KERN_QUANT=0, tag hotfix-eu-503-sha, run smoke tests, then pin. I'll push within 10m.
maria: release note snippet (for changelog): "embeddings: fix 500s in eu-west1 caused by quant kernel regression; temporary quant path disabled for patch." Keep short.
dave: risk note — disabling quant path increases memory/latency slightly. Ops needs to watch memory OOMs.
sean: approving skip-canary for this patch. Conditions: 1) smoke tests pass, 2) automated health checks green for 3 minutes, 3) rollback playbook staged. I +1.
ben: pushed image: sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j. Smoke tests:
```
curl -sS http://eu-west1-embed-smoke/health | jq .status
# => "ok"
curl -sS -X POST http://eu-west1-embed-smoke/predict -d '{"text":"test"}' | jq .status
# => "ok"
```
maria: ran load-smoke 20rps for 60s, no 500s. CPU + mem within expected.
releasebot: To pin the image and fast-track deploy run:
```
/releasebot pin embeddings-service eu-west1 sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j --skip-canary --owner=@ben --reason="urgent quant fallback"
```
Note: This will create an audit entry and run a zero-downtime rollout bypassing canary.
sean: I authorize that command. ben, you execute and monitor. If errors > 1% in next 10m we rollback.
ben: running pin now.
ops-bot: Action logged: pin by ben at 2025-03-22T12:45:30Z. Starting deploy. Canary skipped by policy waiver (oncall+lead).
maria: smoke after deploy: all endpoints responding. quick curl check:
`curl -sS https://eu-west1.embed/api/predict -d '{"text":"hello"}' | jq .status` -> "ok". No 500s.
sean: watching alarms — latency + memory up ~12% but no errors. Monitoring OK for 6 minutes.
lucy: release notes updated: https://internal.redwood/release/notes/embeddings/2025-03-22-hotfix
ben: will leave rollback branch ready and TTL for skip-canary set to 30m.
releasebot: Deploy finished: rollout completed successful (10/10 healthy). Canary skipped per waiver. Marking thread closed. Remember to follow up with perf ticket for quant kernel revert/mitigation.
